pages.text: Beatable alone in iron armour with a dog. These are the dark age's fallout, not its masters.$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Zombie$() → $(bold)Brass$(). The dead carried it off. Brass opens the middle of Create.$(br)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() → $(bold)Recruiting$(): hire squads, arm guards.

$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() → $(bold)Blasting$(): TNT, gunpowder tech, Create's blaze burner.$(br)$(bold)Torte$() (Incendium's skeleton chef, Nether) → $(bold)Advanced cooking$(): Slice & Dice automation, Aquaculture nets. A funny first Nether trip.
